_comment: Ported from CAG 2026-09-16. families_by_page_type scopes which invariant families run per page type. IMG/LAYOUT/NAV are BLOCKING; SEM/SCHEMA/CSS/DUP/A11Y/FORM enter ADVISORY until they have passed their fixtures AND produced zero false reports across one full cluster - the same promotion rule the source harness uses. Registering a check is not wiring it in: on CAG the A11Y family was registered and declared blocking a full day before it appeared here, so it examined ZERO pages while reporting as a shipped gate (Guard 2 in build_scorecard.mjs is what caught it). meta.spec.ts now asserts the symmetric difference between registered families and families named here is empty. DUP's sibling set is every built page (lib/dupCorpus.ts siblingSlugsFor), never 'targets of the same page type', so no page type compares against nothing. Foundation is a verbatim migration of WordPress markup: many failures are expected on migrated bodies and form the baseline for projects 3 and 4; failures caused by the shell (SiteHeader/SiteFooter/Breadcrumb/BaseLayout/PuppyList/ContactForm) are fixed here. `corpus: true` marks the frozen benchmark sample - one page per page type - so the quality trend does not depend on which pages happened to be built that month.
